notes: Four independently funded flat 1000-USDT accounts share one public mark/clock/rules/funding/hourly/5m observation and frozen first-seen factor/event context per tick.
The baseline preserves the selected BTC hourly EMA48/240 threshold-transition and structural pullback policy; no pre-inception origin can create initial inventory.

The candidate alone may create a new post-inception closed-hour structural touch-and-rejection event in the currently confirmed original trend, while independently flat. It has a unique opportunity identity and its own one-hour expiry. The October 8 trend origin is never renewed.

An event must touch a structure known before its hourly candle opened and reject in the trend direction. The original structural builder separately freezes the post-event entry structure; subsequent closed 5m touch/rejection and the original improved-price corridor remain required.

At most three extra events per original trend episode, with a three-hour cooldown after each event and after closing a candidate-event position. No skipped historical hours are replayed as new events.

Original factor/news/funding/quantity/leverage gates, LLM review and 8% soft/15% hard account drawdown controls remain. Original BTC uses confirmed reversal/account controls rather than a per-trade ATR stop; no stock risk budget is silently added.
LLM provider calls run as non-writing background reviews. Pending/unavailable reviews block new risk; all market/source/timing checks run again against fresh observations before execution.

Double costs multiply execution fees and adverse slippage by two. Each arm sizes independently from its own equity and account drawdown. Historical and live account returns are never copied into these ledgers.

Dependency closure, profile/base manifest, experiment configuration and nonsecret execution settings are frozen. Restart requires compatible existing complete ledgers and preserves all balances. No automatic promotion; review thresholds are only a first review scale.
